source: dynamical.org (ECMWF IFS ENS, NOAA GEFS) + Tabulator SLR
attribution: ECMWF and NOAA ensemble data from dynamical.org (CC BY 4.0)

slr.form: SLR = a + b*T, clamped; per region where regions[r].promoted, else pooled
slr.temperature: forecast 2 m, precipitation-weighted, at the point being converted (°C); fitted at station height, applied at the slope
slr.fitted_on: 2024-25, leads 1-3, CoCoRaHS / SLF plots / AMeDAS same-window new snow + water, water >= 2.5 mm, snow > 0, T <= 0.0 C

warm.fitted_on: 2024-25 board windows, leads 1-3, water >= 2.5 mm, bins with >= 30 windows

hourly.fitted_on: 2024-25 board windows, leads 1-3; within-day shape from ERA5 3-hourly at the resort
